description: Use this when the user asks about a Japanese word: what it means, how to read or pronounce it, its pitch accent, whether it is a godan or ichidan verb, how to conjugate it (te-form, past, polite, potential…), or how to say something in Japanese. Searches the 9,040 JLPT words (N5–N1) of Japanese Skills · 言の葉 by the word in kanji or kana (食べる, たべる), romaji (taberu), or a meaning in English, Chinese or Korean (eat, 吃, 먹다). Each result has the reading, JLPT level, the meaning in the user’s language, the pitch accent (accent number, type and H/L pattern), the word class and conjugation table where the site has one, an example sentence with its translation where the site has one, recordings in two voices where available, and the word’s page. Shows a word card in chats that display app UI. Returns no results when the word is not in the list. Not for translating whole sentences.

lang.description: The user’s language for meanings, labels and links: zh-Hans (Simplified Chinese), zh-Hant (Traditional Chinese), en (English) or ko (Korean). Other languages: en. Default: guessed from the query.

limit.description: How many matches to return at most.

query.description: One word: Japanese (食べる, たべる, タベル), romaji (taberu), or a meaning in the user’s language (eat, 吃, 먹다).

name: lookup_word

audio.description: Recordings of the site’s two voices, or null when there is none

pattern.description: H/L per mora, then the particle after the word in brackets
